metadata.title: Logging & Telemetry SSPP
metadata.remarks: This SSPP defines mandatory logging and telemetry requirements to ensure that Security Operations has sufficient, trustworthy observability to support monitoring, detection, response, and forensics.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits authority, workflow, and escalation rules and SHALL NOT redefine decision ownership.

system-characteristics.system-description: Defines required generation, collection, integrity, and retention of security-relevant telemetry across enterprise systems to enable effective Security Operations.

system-implementation.remarks: Telemetry SHALL be generated by design. Absence, degradation, or suppression of required telemetry SHALL be treated as a security control failure.

telemetry-scope.description: Authentication, authorization, privilege use, and identity lifecycle events.
Process execution, service state, configuration changes, and integrity signals.
Connection metadata, flow records, and protocol activity required for behavioral analysis.
Application activity, API usage, errors, and security-relevant state transitions.

telemetry-requirements.statement: Systems SHALL generate security-relevant telemetry sufficient to reconstruct user and process activity.
Telemetry SHALL be collected centrally or in a manner that supports correlation and analysis.
Telemetry SHALL be protected against unauthorized modification or deletion.
All telemetry SHALL include reliable time synchronization to support accurate event correlation.
Telemetry SHALL be retained for a duration sufficient to support detection, investigation, and forensic requirements.

failure-handling.statement: Loss or degradation of required telemetry SHALL itself generate an escalation signal.
Sustained telemetry gaps SHALL escalate as control violations under the Violation & Drift Escalation SSPP.

control-implementation.description: Controls ensure that telemetry supports continuous monitoring, incident handling, and forensic investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security-relevant events are defined and logged.
Audit records contain sufficient detail to support analysis and accountability.
Audit information is reviewed and correlated to support monitoring and detection.
Time stamps are generated and synchronized to support event correlation.
Audit information is protected against unauthorized modification and deletion.
Audit records are retained to support investigations.
Telemetry supports system monitoring for security-relevant activity.

statements.statement: Security Operations SHALL NOT rely on inferred behavior where required telemetry is absent.
Detection, response, or automation actions SHALL NOT be suppressed due to logging deficiencies.
Telemetry SHALL be treated as evidentiary data once an incident or forensic hold is declared.
Operational convenience SHALL NOT justify disabling or reducing required telemetry.

back-matter.remarks: Downstream SSPPs for Monitoring, Detection, Incident Response, SOAR, and Digital Forensics SHALL assume telemetry requirements defined in this SSPP.
